title: Video: Apple (AAPL) and Four Other Business Stories You Must See Thursday
text:
Here's everything you need to know before Thursday's opening bell : 

Cloud computing saw Microsoft ( MSFT ) exceed expectations for its fiscal second quarter. Mark Zuckerberg said a newsfeed change lowered the time spent on Facebook ( FB ) by roughly 50 million hours. eBay ( EBAY ) said it would not extend its agreement with PayPal ( PYPL ) . Investors await earnings from Alphabet ( GOOGL ) , Amazon ( AMZN ) and Apple ( AAPL ) . U.S. stock futures were mixed ahead of a busy day of earnings. Watch More with TheStreet :
